title: Los mayas
goal: Read about Maya writing and the Olmec 'mother culture', and explain what was long assumed about why southern cities were abandoned.
grammar: Voz pasiva y se pasiva en textos históricos

items: Explain who deciphered Maya writing and how many distinct glyphs have been identified.
Describe what the Olmecs devised, such as the ritual ballgame, the jaguar cult and the 260-day calendar.
Name a Maya architectural achievement and what makes it remarkable.
Explain what was long believed about why the southern Maya cities were abandoned.
Use ser + participle and se-passive to describe historical events.
